exposure: immunoglobulin M endotoxin core antibodies to lipopolysaccharide (EndoCAb) levels
cohort: The study included 36 pregnant women with HIV infection and 36 pregnant women without HIV infection, matched on the basis of age and parity.
finding: Higher levels of sCD14 and LBP were observed in HIV-infected pregnant women and were associated with preterm delivery, with an independent association found between first trimester sCD14 levels and preterm delivery among HIV-infected women.
